17082.d: Material caches (aetherium alloy) are Archaeology material caches that can be found in the Stormguard Citadel Dig Site at either the Research & Development north-east or north-west excavation sites, and at the Empyrean Citadel excavation site.
17082.ex: An excavation full of archaeological materials.
